patch_description:
Replace the clipped concentric-ring layout with a staggered near-hexagonal seed and a deterministic constrained local optimization over all centers and radii. The staggered rows provide substantially better initial density than the previous outer ring, whose clipped centers created many nearly coincident circles.

The optimization directly maximizes the total radius subject to all four wall constraints per circle and every pairwise non-overlap constraint. Several small deterministic perturbations of the geometric seed are used because boundary effects and unequal radii can lead to different local optima. Analytic constraint derivatives keep SLSQP practical. Finally, a global feasibility rescaling is applied from the actual returned geometry; this preserves the optimized relative radii while protecting against floating-point constraint tolerances.
